content: # CoolAid's NoSignGUI ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/載入器-Fabric%2fForge%2fNeoForge-red?style=for-the-badge) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/版本-1.20_|_1.21_|_26.1_|_26.2-red?style=for-the-badge) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/運行環境-客戶端-red?style=for-the-badge) ### 允許您開關告示牌文字介面！ - **這在建造或設置陷阱時大量使用空白告示牌尤其實用** - **預設按下 `G` 鍵即可切換模組開關** - **靈感來自 [Masonion 的 NoSignGUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/nosigngui) 模組** - **支援懸掛告示牌，且完全在客戶端運作** #### 如有任何問題或功能建議，請至 [GitHub](https://github.com/CoolAid48/NoSignGUI/issues) 提交報告 [](https://ko-fi.com/coolaid48) [](https://discord.gg/J2SGshKNah) [](https://www.twitch.tv/coolaid48)
